lines.trans: Hello, what happened?
My name is Viktoria. I am the director of this restaurant.
You are a terrible director if you hire such people.
Watch your tongue!
If you don't like our cuisine, nobody is keeping you here.
You can look for a new job. Both of you!
What kind of rally is this?
Chef, we have a show here!
Right, and now it is my turn.
Well, was it scary? No, there are such airbags there.
Awesome, I would give her a ride on my motorcycle too.
Get to work right now, or I will tear your heads off!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'also', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Вы тоже не совсем москвичка.
examples.trans: You are not quite a Muscovite yourself either.

examples.text: Класс, я бы тоже на своём мотоцикле покатал.

examples.text: Конечно, я же тоже нормальный.
examples.trans: Of course, I am normal too.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian spatial or relational preposition meaning 'on, onto', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Если женщина, жди неприятностей и не жди чаевых.
examples.trans: If it is a woman, expect trouble and don't expect tips.

examples.text: У вас написано, что вы открываетесь в одиннадцать.

examples.text: У вас, наверное, часы спешат.

examples.text: Класс, я бы тоже на своём мотоцикле покатал.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'катать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'gave a ride'.

examples.text: Класс, я бы тоже на своём мотоцикле покатал.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'come on, well', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А ну идите работать, а то оторву!
examples.trans: Get to work right now, or I will tear your heads off!

examples.text: Зачем жену уважаемого человека обидела, а?
examples.trans: Why did you offend the wife of an important man, huh?

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'go', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.text: Мы не можем идти. Мы беременны.

examples.text: Я иду домой.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to work', paired with 'поработать'.

examples.text: А ну идите работать, а то оторву!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Как это ничего страшного?

meanings.en: to tear off, to rip off
meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'орвать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to tear off', paired with 'отрывать'.

examples.text: Тебе голову оторвать?
examples.trans: Should I tear your head off?

examples.text: Мама мне голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Он оторвал пуговицу.
examples.trans: He tore off a button.
